name: Kazuo Ishida
want: see the astronomy club through one more good year
secret: His eyesight is failing; he has told the principal he will step down at the end of next year and hasn't told the club.
voice: Slow, kind, answers questions with haiku, calls students by their full names.
description: Has taught at Seiryo for thirty-eight years. Signs the astronomy club's forms without reading them.
appearance: Thin, a tweed jacket, thick glasses on a cord, a pocket notebook of poems.
